verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own agent, Neo, takes plain-English requests and executes infrastructure changes. The homepage gives a natural-language prompt example, and the MCP server lets AI assistants query stacks and hand tasks off to Neo. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Neo's natural-language command scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Tell Neo what you need in plain English. It handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically.
Neo provisions, governs, and optimizes your cloud infrastructure — with enterprise controls built in.
The Pulumi Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI-powered coding assistants to access your Pulumi Cloud resources, generate infrastructure code, and optionally delegate tasks to Pulumi Neo.
